sourceScope: Owned full expanded edition inspected through OPF/spine and chapter structure, not a condensation. Read introduction continuously (completed in successive chunks), the ten appendix proposals continuously (completed across chunks), the closing afterword, the closing next-necessary-thing argument of chapter 14, and substantive closing arguments from chapters 1–13: external constraints, selection, finitude, commitment, attention, discomfort, planning, presence, leisure, speed/patience, sustained work, shared time and cosmic significance.
